_note: KSP1PartMod animation settings. enabled: master switch for KSP1 animations. fix_mu_reader: patch Redux's .mu reader so models of format version 0 to 2 load (false leaves Redux untouched). own_first_deployable: remove Redux's deployable module from the part and let KSP1PartMod play that clip too. follow_redux_deployables: Redux keeps the state of a part's single deployable (and of parachutes) but its Mecanim copy of the clip does not move; KSP1PartMod draws the clip from Redux's state (false leaves those clips still). hide_material_less_renderers: hide the renderers of KSP1 parts whose materials are all missing (drawn with Unity's error colour). fix_part_icons: light KSP1 part icons: give the icon subject the rendering layers of the icon studio's lights (false keeps Redux's black icons). editor_animation_speed: speed of KSP1 animations in the VAB, times the flight speed: 1 = real speed (default, smooth), 1000 = instant, 0 = KSP1's own editor values (x10 for doors and panels, gear and legs instant). shader_property_map: KSP1 material property -> KSP2 property names to try, in order; when present it replaces the built-in map. subcategory_bar: in the VAB, a second vertical bar of KSP1 part types (Pods, Engines, Robotics...) next to the category bar when a KSP1 mod category is selected (false removes it). diagnostics: log once, in the VAB, the materials of a few KSP1 parts (lines '[KSP1PartMod] diag:'), for bug reports.
